candidates.title: Mentra App account-switch deep-link security hotfix merged to staging
candidates.summary: MentraOS PR #4947 describes a phone companion-app account isolation flaw in reset and signup links: an opened link could replace the current signed-in account without consent, risking data association with a different account. The developer says 3.2 main shares the affected code. Staging fix merged October 25 00:31 UTC, with 138 upstream tests; production distribution, exploit reports, and independent device reproduction are not established.

candidates.title: Mentra App launcher repair for off-screen Home apps and hidden developer shortcut
candidates.summary: MentraOS PR #4943 reports that Add to Home from All Apps could save drawer coordinates and displace existing Home apps off-screen when no saved layout existed; the developer shortcut also ignored its launcher visibility setting. Merged October 24 03:10 UTC, with 149 upstream tests. The PR says device coverage for exact Add to Home regression remains absent. No claim of erased apps or independently verified consumer rollout.

candidates.title: Mentra Live upstream request for video recording without dropping WHIP stream
candidates.summary: MentraOS issue #4924 documents a developer proposal to borrow the camera for a bounded video recording while the live WHIP stream substitutes black frames. The requester reports a local prototype and build/tests but explicitly no physical-glasses validation, and the upstream issue remains an open feature request, not a shipped capability. Useful camera concurrency and failure-recovery research lead.

candidates.title: Mentra Bluetooth SDK request for scriptable native simulated-glasses testing
candidates.summary: MentraOS issue #4931 requests public native Android/iOS simulated-glasses APIs with display output, mic PCM, touch, head-up, and disconnect injection. The author reports current simulator access is React-Native-only and native SDK simulation is insufficient for CI; the request is open, not an implemented SDK feature.
